Cloudflare Wrangler

Usage:
  wrangler [command]

Commands:
  dev         Start a local development server
  deploy      Deploy your Worker to Cloudflare
  publish     Publish your Worker (alias of deploy)
  secret      Manage Worker secrets
  kv          Manage Workers KV namespaces
  r2          Manage R2 buckets
  d1          Manage D1 databases
  logs        Tail logs from a Worker
  triggers    Manage routes and domains for a Worker
  whoami      Display your account and Wrangler configuration

Flags:
  -j, --json             Return output as JSON
  -c, --config path      Path to the Wrangler configuration file
  -e, --env name         Environment to use for commands
  -h, --help             Show help
